primary_endpoint: Fibrosis regression in participants with MASH-associated F2 or F3 fibrosis at 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 24 weeks, fibrosis regression occurred in 8 placebo participants, 15 receiving efruxifermin 28 mg (p=0.025), and 14 receiving 50 mg (p=0.036); both comparisons were significant by Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: placebo 4/43, efruxifermin 28 mg 4/40, and 50 mg 7/43; no deaths in any group.
